name: Whiteface Mountain
description: As an Allied Resort partner, Whiteface gives Indy Passholders up to 2 daily lift tickets at 25% off the daily window rate. The 1980 Olympic alpine races were held on Whiteface, and the mountain hasn’t softened since. You get 3,166 feet of lift-served vertical, plus The Slides, an expert-only hike-to zone that stretches the drop to 3,430 feet, the biggest in the East. Snowmaking covers nearly every trail. Bring your legs.
